title: OpenAI ships Codex rust-v0.158.0
summary: OpenAI releases Codex rust-v0.158.0 with TUI configuration improvements, MCP OAuth support, and robust WebSocket authentication.

items.name: codex
items.what: Lightweight coding agent running in the terminal with improved TUI and MCP support.
items.whyDifferent: Adds bearer token security for direct WebSocket connections and native MCP OAuth client secret connections.

items.name: langchainjs
items.what: Agent engineering platform updating createAgent error handling behavior.
items.whyDifferent: Prevents run termination on failed returnDirect tool calls, routing schema errors back to the model for correction.

readThrough: Agent runtimes and developer frameworks are tightening security controls and error recovery paths. Upgrading to these releases ensures robust WebSocket authentication and reliable tool execution retry handling; teams should test it in a reversible pilot before adoption.

social.linkedin: Agent runtimes and developer frameworks are tightening security controls and error recovery paths. OpenAI's Codex rust-v0.158.0 introduces bearer token protection for WebSocket connections alongside MCP OAuth support. Meanwhile, LangchainJS 1.5.14 refines agent execution loops by returning tool errors to models for correction rather than terminating runs outright. Upgrading gives teams tighter transport boundaries and more resilient autonomous workflows.
social.instagram: Agent runtimes harden authentication and transport boundaries. Codex v0.158.0 adds secure WebSocket connections and MCP OAuth support, while LangchainJS 1.5.14 improves tool error recovery.
social.x: Agent runtimes harden authentication boundaries with new secure WebSocket controls and resilient error recovery.
social.facebook: Agent runtimes and developer frameworks are tightening security controls and error recovery paths. OpenAI's Codex rust-v0.158.0 introduces bearer token protection for direct WebSocket connections and pre-registered OAuth client secrets for MCP servers. Simultaneously, LangchainJS 1.5.14 refines agent execution loops by routing failed tool arguments back to the model for automated correction. These updates give engineering teams more secure transport boundaries and robust error handling.
